sec.title: September 4 Archival Metadata Enrichment (Increment 772)
sec.p: This archival dispatch documents the historical provenance, broadcast scheduling, commercial sponsorship, credited cast, production personnel, alternate circulating titles, and pure narrative synopses for broadcasts transmitting on **September 4** across America's definitive pop music survey on *Your Hit Parade* featuring Frank Sinatra singing *You'll Never Know* (1943) and Leo Reisman (1937) for Lucky Strike Cigarettes, jazz icon Lena Horne backed by Count Basie's big band on *Jubilee* for AFRS, Ezra Stone's teenage panic on *The Aldrich Family* for Jell-O, William Gargan in *I Deal in Crime*, and Bob & Ray's satirical Arthur Godfrey parody, Frank Sinatra & Joan Edwards (1943), Lena Horne & Count Basie (1944), Ezra Stone (1941), and Bob and Ray (1937–1948):
